description: Angular component for an image dialog, including image editing, uploading, embedding, downloading, and exporting functionalities within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: ImageDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing image dialog interactions, including editing image info, embedding, uploading, downloading, and exporting images.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up the component state.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog, returning the image if it was changed.

methods.name: revertInfo
methods.description: Reverts the image title to its original value.

methods.name: saveInfo
methods.description: Saves the updated image information via the image service.

methods.name: downloadImage
methods.description: Triggers image download through the image service.

methods.name: exportImage
methods.description: Exports the image using the import-export service.

methods.name: embedImage
methods.description: Opens a dialog to embed an image and updates the image data upon completion.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Opens a dialog to upload a new image and updates the image data upon completion.
